title: Coordinator / Router for Navigation Logic
hints: Model screens as an enum; the router owns the stack array and the sheet.
Each event mutates the stack/sheet according to one rule.
jsBridge: A coordinator/router moves navigation decisions out of views into testable logic, like centralising route changes in a React Router action or a Redux navigation slice, instead of scattering `navigate()` calls.

compass.q: `navigate('/checkout')` scattered in components vs a central router: which is easier to test and deep-link?
A flow that ends by dismissing a sheet *and* popping to root: who owns that sequence?
UIKit coordinators vs SwiftUI `NavigationPath` owned by a router object: what carried over?
Would you adopt a routing library (SwiftfulRouting) or keep a small in-house router?
